Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be 
 performed every one year as indicated by (Y1) in the above title block.
This pump is used to Alum Sulphate injection into plat filter press
The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Mageed Elhenawey, tested at September 
 2008 revised by MDEPCo. Quality control Eng. Magdy Hegazy, accepted by 
 eng . Magdy Okba, and approved by eng Saeed Sowan
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; MEPC inspection & quality 
 control general Manager& MPIS coordinator, and certified by Eng Mohamed Nageeb 
 inspection & quality control's head sector.
Polymer dosing pumps | P-018A/B
MANUFACTUR | OBL
MODEL | XL 50 PP 22 82 DV Z 92 M3052
PUMP TYPE | Spring return mechanism mechanical diaphragm 
 metering pump . mechanism and gearbox enclosed in an oil bath lubricated 
 anodized aluminum casing. double ball valve
Reagent availability | 0.5% polymer
Quanttty | 2 (Duty / istandby)
Dosage per stream | 170 L/H
pump capacity & duty | 215 L/H
Max. pressure | 15 bar
Strokes per minute | 70
Head | 150 M
Speed | 1450 R.P.M CW
El motor power | 1.5 KW
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes breathing mask ... etc
Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor
Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the pump motor
Isolate the pump mechanically by 
 closing delivery and suction valves
Be sure pump must be completely 
 drainage
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid. Manual puller.
Work to be 
carried out
Pump in 
 operation
Check pump capacity, pressure and power
Check the Noisy of the Pump.
Check the level of oil
Check the pump leaks
Pump out of operation
Adjust oil level
Check the fixation of bolt
Adjust the pump and piping for leaks
Starting the Pump
Before starting the pump, the following steps should be checked
Open suction and delivery valve
Check the direction of rotation of motor before starting it is clockwise
Attendance and checking during 
operation of the pump the following should be checked
Check of flow rate , delivery head and absorbed power.
Check the water leakage of pump
Check the pump noise
